release_read.basis: Q3 adjusted EBITDA $32.1M above the top of the $25-30M guide, gross margin 45.2% vs 40.2%, adj EPS $0.16 vs Nasdaq's single-estimate $0.09, and revolver paid down to $1.5M with debt down $45M y/y; FY guide only reiterated (no raise), which caps it below the +10-18% of the last three margin beats.

release.headline: Funko Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast (fallback, 1 estimate), from brief
company Q3 guide $25-30M midpoint (hunt/judge notes say consensus sat on the guide)

key_line.detail: $32.1M, above the top end; gross margin 45.2% above expectations. Revenue consensus not found in time (released time approximate: after the close, before the 16:30 ET webcast).

guidance.detail: FY2026 net sales flat to +3%, adj EBITDA $100-110M (incl. $25.4M Q2 tariff benefit), GM 46-47% reiterated; no Q4 guide. A reiterated FY after a Q3 beat implies a softer Q4 than the street may have had (fable51 flagged the soft implied Q4).

call.detail: Webcast held last night; content not reviewed in the time available. The -20% after-hours move suggests the implied Q4 / call carried the damage, not the Q3 lines.

public_reaction.summary: One search found no November 2026 coverage yet; no analyst actions found in time.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 5.06 (-17.5%) vs frozen release read +9%: a 26-point gap the opposite way. After-hours 4.90 (-20.1%), pre-market range 4.94-5.46. Only 12 prints, none in the last 30 minutes, last at 08:44: stale_at_open true, so the open is unreliable. Move exceeds the 13.55% historical median reaction. Market flat (SPY +0.2%, IWM +0.4%). Read as overshoot against the release lines, though the market likely knows something from the call/implied Q4 I could not verify.

thesis_check.note: The Q3 lines confirm the thesis (EBITDA above the top of the guide), but the price says the market read the reiterated FY / implied Q4 or the call as a negative; the thesis that a beat pays +10-18% is contradicted by the tape.

expected.open_lag_note: amc move had a whole night and the after-hours (-20%) and pre-market (-17.5%) agree, so the open should mostly hold it; stale pre-market adds uncertainty. A gap beyond the implied move, against Q3 lines that beat, tends to give part back in the first half hour.

recommendation.reason: De positie staat ongeveer 17% in het verlies, hoewel het kwartaal zelf boven de eigen prognose uitkwam; de daling is groter dan normaal voor dit aandeel. Grote openingsgaten geven vaak een deel terug in het eerste halfuur, en de pre-market is dun en oud (laatste koers 08:44), dus verkoop om 10:00 in plaats van bij de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als er voor 09:30 nieuws of een analistenverlaging verschijnt die de daling verklaart (bijvoorbeeld een zwak vierde kwartaal), of de pre-market verder onder 4,94 zakt, dan gewoon bij de opening verkopen.
